_comment: PLACEHOLDER credentials -- MUST be rotated before any real/public deployment (these hashes are in a public repo). To set a team/admin password: run `npm run hash "newPassword"` and paste the output into password_hash, then redeploy. `grade` is a free-text label shown to admins. `language` is only the fallback default now -- students pick their language on the login screen. See README for the dev-only default passwords.
